title: Folding Saw – Industrial with Non-Slip Grip
descriptionHtml:
The branch has been in the way all summer

The chainsaw feels like overkill, the bow saw is hanging at the very back of the shed – so the branch gets to stay. Again.

The solution: a saw that lives in your pocket

An industrial folding saw that unfolds in a second and bites right in. A non-slip, durable handle gives full control – and no cords, no batteries, no maintenance.

Features

  • Always ready – no cords, no batteries
  • Safe in your pocket – unfolds in a second
  • Won't slip out of your hand – non-slip, durable grip
  • Built for real work – industrial grade
  • For garden, camping and hunting

Change of mind
